attempts.text: [{"name": "item_momentum_30_60", "idea": "Growth of an item's audience: distinct users in the last 30 steps divided by distinct users in the 30 steps before that, plus one; this captures a longer-horizon trend than users_7/users_30.", "level": "item", "sql": "SELECT item_id, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t >= {A} - 30 THEN user_id END) AS DOUBLE) / (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t < {A} - 30 THEN user_id END) + 1) AS ag_mom_30_60 FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 60 GROUP BY item_id;"}, {"name": "cooc_recent30", "idea": "Item-item cosine co-occurrence computed only on the last 30 steps and summed over the user's last 10 items, so it reflects current co-purchase patterns rather than 180-step ones.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH r AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30), n AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM r GROUP BY item_id), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn <= 10), src AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM lu), co AS (SELECT a.item_id AS i, b.item_id AS j, COUNT(*) AS c FROM r a JOIN r b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.item_id <> b.item_id WHERE a.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM src) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(co.c / sqrt(ni.c * nj.c)) AS ag_cooc30 FROM cand c JOIN lu ON lu.user_id = c.user_id JOIN co ON co.i = lu.item_id AND co.j = c.item_id JOIN n ni ON ni.item_id = co.i JOIN n nj ON nj.item_id = co.j GROUP BY 1, 2;"}, {"name": "next_item_transition", "idea": "Directed sequential signal: across all users in the last 180 steps, the share of users of each of u's last 3 items who took item j within the following 10 steps, summed over those items.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH e AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, t FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 180), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn <= 3), src AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM lu), ni AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e WHERE item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM src) GROUP BY item_id), tr AS (SELECT a.item_id AS i, b.item_id AS j, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e a JOIN e b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND b.t > a.t AND b.t <= a.t + 10 WHERE a.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM src) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(CAST(tr.c AS DOUBLE) / ni.c) AS ag_next_tr FROM cand c JOIN lu ON lu.user_id = c.user_id JOIN tr ON tr.i = lu.item_id AND tr.j = c.item_id JOIN ni ON ni.item_id = tr.i GROUP BY 1, 2;"}, {"name": "user_pop_pref", "idea": "How mainstream the user is: the mean of ln(1 + users_30) over the user's last 20 items, so the model can match candidate popularity to user taste.", "level": "user", "sql": "WITH ip AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30 GROUP BY item_id), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn <= 20) SELECT lu.user_id, AVG(LN(1 + COALESCE(ip.c, 0))) AS ag_user_pop_pref FROM lu LEFT JOIN ip ON ip.item_id = lu.item_id GROUP BY lu.user_id;"}, {"name": "user_cf_recent", "idea": "User-based collaborative filtering: the summed cosine similarity of u's top-50 neighbours (by item overlap in the last 90 steps) who interacted with item j in the last 30 steps.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH e AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 90), du AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e GROUP BY user_id), uu AS (SELECT a.user_id AS u, b.user_id AS v, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e a JOIN e b ON a.item_id = b.item_id AND a.user_id <> b.user_id WHERE a.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) GROUP BY 1, 2), nb AS (SELECT u, v, s FROM (SELECT uu.u, uu.v, uu.c / sqrt(d1.c * d2.c) AS s, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uu.u ORDER BY uu.c / sqrt(d1.c * d2.c) DESC, uu.v) AS rn FROM uu JOIN du d1 ON d1.user_id = uu.u JOIN du d2 ON d2.user_id = uu.v) x WHERE rn <= 50), r AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(nb.s) AS ag_ucf30 FROM cand c JOIN nb ON nb.u = c.user_id JOIN r ON r.user_id = nb.v AND r.item_id = c.item_id GROUP BY 1, 2;"}]
